item.tib: lta sgom nyams kyi man ngag
item.coloph: zab mo snyan gyi rgyud pa'i/ lta sgom nyams su blang ba'i man ngag 'di/ skye shis 'jigs pa'i dad ldan la/ gzhan bstan par ma sungs (gsungs) te/ ye shes dbal mo'i bka' rgya yod/ lta sgom nyams kyi man ngag 'di/ kun tu bzang dgongs pa yin/ gshen sgom thugs kyis brnag pa yin/ ldong sgom nam mkha'i nyams len yin//
